column1: # Weight trees published in the R2 weights store (bucket fv-weights, docs/ops/r2-weights.md).
# One row per published manifest (manifests/<dest>/<rev>.json), recorded AFTER `r2-weights.py publish-*`
# and `r2-weights.py verify --deep` passed; `r2-weights.py record` prints these rows.
# fv-control (control/gen-configs.mjs -> src/weights-sources.ts R2_TREES) offers weights_source r2 only
# for trees listed here, and refuses a manifest whose SHA-256 differs from the one pinned here.
# rev: the Hub revision (40 hex) for Hub trees, as weights-revisions.tsv; for volume-only trees the
# label given to publish-dir (eu-<YYYYMMDD>: the day it was copied off the EU volume jg48s6o1w0).
# source hub-via-dir: a Hub tree copied from the EU volume, every file checked against the Hub listing at the
# pinned revision (LFS SHA-256 / git blob SHA-1) before its upload completed; dir: a volume-only tree.
# 2026-10-11/12: all 46 trees copied off the EU volume jg48s6o1w0 (docs/ops/r2-weights.md §10).
